amendments.body: High: crates/tank_harness/tests/e2e_habitat_geometry_probes.rs:912-965,1002-1028,1115-1122,1142-1149 regress the redox probe by giving the inert arm the same low-DO/high-decomposer baseline as the planted arm and then asserting that the inert control stays fully oxic and its denitrifier activity decays. On the current code, the inert setup starts with about 455.6 cm³ of suboxic pore volume and its denitrifier activity rises from 0.1000 to 0.1333, so both probe_substrate_redox_denitrification and all_habitat_geometry_probes_summary fail under cargo test -p tank_harness --test e2e_habitat_geometry_probes -- --nocapture. The control needs different initial conditions, or the assertions need to stop assuming a fully oxic inert bed.
amendments.rationale: This is a real regression: the newly added probe suite no longer passes, and the test's mechanistic claim about the inert control is currently false.

amendments.body: Medium: crates/tank_harness/tests/e2e_habitat_geometry_probes.rs:1133-1140 hard-codes planted_final_activity > planted_initial_activity + 0.3. The current run finishes at 0.3983 from a 0.1000 start, so the probe now fails by 0.0017 even though the planted arm still shows the intended behavior (66.28 mg N exported vs 1.33 mg N in the control). That cutoff is too brittle for a scenario test that is supposed to survive reasonable retuning; it should be a looser directional/envelope check instead of a near-exact activity threshold.
amendments.rationale: Even after fixing the control setup, this assertion remains an unnecessary flake point and conflicts with the bead's requirement for retuning-resilient checks.

payload.summary: Reviewed the diff in crates/tank_harness/tests/e2e_habitat_geometry_probes.rs, read the file end-to-end, and ran cargo test -p tank_harness --test e2e_habitat_geometry_probes -- --nocapture. I found two substantive issues in the new redox probe: the inert control is not actually oxic anymore, and the added planted-activity threshold is brittle enough to fail on the current baseline.
